title: The worst don’t do it
body: They will charge you $95 for an annual subscription and on top of that just be a terrible app. 0/100 don’t fall for the scam.

title: Free Trial is a SCAM / Immediate Charge!
body: I would like an immediate refund please, as the message said to proceed with a Trial for 3 days and ONLY after that will a yearly subscription start. I tap okay, and boom, charged immediately. Refund please.

title: App has been broken for months.
body: I feel ripped off. I paid for a year. I would like my money back.

title: Disappointed
body: Southwest Airlines flights are not supported with this app. I emailed customer support for help and got no response(twice). Paying for an entire year subscription was a waste of money.

title: Doesn’t work
body: Was hopeful for this app but it was a big disappointment and a waste of money. Videos don’t load, flight info never loads.

title: Crashes
body: Crashes whenever I try to track a flight. That’s the main feature of the app, so yeah, I canceled my subscription.

title: Buggy and changing to navigate
body: Sound works intermittently. Feels piecemeal, production is cheap and translations of written entries feel very...translated. Can't believe it costs what it does.

title: Hi
body: Awesome App ! Flight Buddy genuinely helped me before and during my flight. The turbulence forecast was amazing — knowing what to expect kept me calm even when it got bumpy. Now I’m taking the in-app course and feel way more confident about flying. Highly recommend for anyone with flight anxiety. Just flew without freaking out for the first time in a long while — thanks to this app.

title: Decent turbulence forecast
body: Loved the way they audio guide you through all the steps of the flight. My fear of flying is mostly based on lack of knowledge as my therapist explained to me. Kudos to developers, the app gives a pretty good explanations to everything I needed to start flying again. Another great feature is the turbulence forecast. I cannot stop thinking about it during the whole flight time. Knowing where it can hit the plane helps me “tune”my mind right. Keep it going guys, so grateful to you!

title: First time- Really impressed
body: I felt really empowered having more information about my flight and when I could expect turbulence. It also really helped with the quiz stating facts about how the wings are designed to withstand much harder forces than just wind. Luckily this 7 hour flight had minor turbulence but when it was bumpy I wasn’t anxious which is a first in a really really long time - Thank you!

title: Trusted app for anxious flyers
body: Wow! This app excels in turbulence forecasting during flights and offers comprehensive information for people who fear flying, including guides and video courses. Totally recommended!

title: Great app
body: Great job! This app helped a ton and it’s not just surface stuff

title: The best!
body: Without a doubt, the best investment I've made in years! Especially the Fear of Flying video course. This app was an absolute game-changer in helping me overcome my fear of flying. Not only has it equipped me with invaluable knowledge, but it has also unlocked countless opportunities for me. I regret not finding it earlier! A huge thank you to the developers and the entire team behind this app for their incredible help and support. Highly recommended!

title: It helped me so much!
body: I just can’t overstate how much this app helped me to fight my fear and anxiety! Omg i think I can say that I enjoyed flying again since long time ago !!! It literally answered all my questions, straightened up my misunderstandings of the processes and just added so much to my knowledge of all the stages of a flight. it all just simply made sense and felt freaking good - I can’t believe it . Last time on a plane I was crying during the take off. This time I knew everything was alright . The language they use on the app, the jokes, the facts , even calming exercises are just on point. I was following each stage of our flight with a specific section on the app and felt like a pro!!(ones again : after crying like a baby last time !!) Also first I read all the “what ifs” and this on its own made me realize just how silly some of my fears are . Again : so informative , so funny , so on point !!!!!! Thank you , sincerely for those who just made my life easier ( now I tearing up from happiness )

title: Love this app.
body: This app really helps me. It reminds me that a lot of my fears are irrational.

title: Great!
body: Just started using the app and am already enjoying it!
